title: PPAR-gamma agonist pioglitazone improves endometrial receptivity, reverses endometrial barrier disruption and promotes ovarian function in thin endometrium rats via modulation PPAR-gamma/Wnt5/beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Li, Heqiao; Guan, Yu; Chen, Xinru; Tian, Wenfan; Xie, Jinghong; Yang, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PPAR-γ激动剂吡格列酮改善薄型子宫内膜大鼠的子宫内膜容受性与卵巢功能，涉及Wnt5/β-catenin通路，但核心是动物实验与病理表型，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Thin endometrium (TE) is a common reproductive endocrine disorder, PPAR-gamma has been reported to regulate cell proliferation and crosstalk with the Wnt5/beta-catenin pathway. However, whether PPAR-gamma promotes endometrial epithelial cell proliferation and acts through the Wnt5/beta-catenin pathway has not been explored. A rat model of endometrial thinning was established and administered for 15 days, and the morphology of the uterus and ovaries was observed by HE staining. Serum sex hormone levels were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). The morphology of endometrial surface was observed by electron microscopy. Immunohistochemistry was used to detect the expression of endometrial receptivity, endometrial barrier and ovarian function proteins. Activation of PPAR-gamma/Wnt5/beta-catenin pathway was analyzed by molecular docking and Western blotting. The results showed that PIO improved endometrial morphology, endometrial thickness, gland number and expression of endometrial tolerance-related proteins, and promoted the repair of endometrial barrier in TE rats. Serum hormone levels, mature follicle and corpus luteum numbers were increased, indicating improved ovarian function. PIO downregulated the Wnt5/beta-catenin signaling pathway and increased the expression of ovarian endocrine-related proteins, as shown by western blot analysis. Our findings revealed that thr PPAR-gamma agonist pioglitazone inhibited the Wnt5/beta-catenin pathway by up-regulating the expression of PPAR-gamma and promoted the proliferation of epithelial cells and the repair of the endometrial barrier, which played a role in protecting ovarian function while treating TE.
abstract_zh: 薄型子宫内膜（TE）是一种常见的生殖内分泌疾病，已有报道称PPAR-γ可调节细胞增殖并与Wnt5/β-catenin通路发生串扰。然而，PPAR-γ是否促进子宫内膜上皮细胞增殖并通过Wnt5/β-catenin通路发挥作用尚未被探讨。建立大鼠子宫内膜变薄模型并给药15天，通过HE染色观察子宫和卵巢的形态。采用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）测量血清性激素水平。通过电子显微镜观察子宫内膜表面形态。使用免疫组织化学检测子宫内膜容受性、子宫内膜屏障和卵巢功能蛋白的表达。通过分子对接和Western blotting分析PPAR-γ/Wnt5/β-catenin通路的激活。结果表明，PIO改善了TE大鼠的子宫内膜形态、子宫内膜厚度、腺体数量和子宫内膜耐受相关蛋白的表达，并促进了子宫内膜屏障的修复。血清激素水平、成熟卵泡和黄体数量增加，表明卵巢功能得到改善。Western blot分析显示，PIO下调了Wnt5/β-catenin信号通路并增加了卵巢内分泌相关蛋白的表达。我们的研究结果揭示，PPAR-γ激动剂吡格列酮通过上调PPAR-γ的表达抑制Wnt5/β-catenin通路，促进上皮细胞增殖和子宫内膜屏障修复，在治疗TE的同时对卵巢功能起到保护作用。
